answer: Weight accrues only to identities that lock 100 units as an insurance stake for 60 days, forfeited when an audit finds copied or cloned work. An audit requires the operator to push an onyx ball weighing 20 grams through an inlet cut to 21 millimeters, then bend a willow rod 50 centimeters long around the ball without breaking it, with the measurements recorded and compared across identities. One operator passes one setup at a time, so 100 fakes need 100 stakes and 100 passes, and a repeated measurement exposes a reused setup.
